messages:
priya_csm: Kicking off LumenCloud onboarding thread. Objective: pilot Redwood Hosted for smart search + chat, with Dedicated considered if cost/latency warrants. Proposed sync: Fri 11/3 8:30am PT. Quick agenda: intros, success metrics, access (SSO/API), data handoff, infra sizing, enablement timeline, procurement/legal risks, next steps. Who can make it?

oliver_cs: I can take enablement and the post-pilot feedback plan. 8:30am works.

lumencloud_pm: PM + infra lead available. We'll provide a redacted dataset (~40MB NDJSON), list of top queries, and a procurement contact.

jamie_se: Ill own integration + SSO. Need test credentials and example user flows. Also please confirm log retention policy.

rina_eng: I can handle Dedicated sizing and smoke tests. I'll run bench runs once the sample is uploaded and post results.

sam_successops: Draft success criteria to start:
- Pilot demo validated by LumenCloud PM + internal CS lead
- Top 8 user journeys pass staging (happy + two edge cases)
- p50 latency under 300ms for typical requests OR documented tradeoff with cost
- Runbook + incident owner assigned
- Procurement path and PO estimate documented before week 3

priya_csm: High-level timeline suggestion:
Week 0: Kickoff & discovery (this meeting)
Week 1: Access setup (SSO, test keys), sample upload, legal check-in
Week 2: Integration & enablement session 1 (power users)
Week 3: Pilot (limited traffic) + feedback capture
Week 4: Demo + go/no-go + handoff prep

lumencloud_pm: Legal wants a short note on data retention before we push sample to staging. We can share legal@lumencloud.example as POC. Procurement requests an early PO ballpark.

jamie_se: Requesting LumenCloud IP ranges for allowlist and a service account for uploads. Note: infra needs 48h lead for allowlist changes.

rina_eng: For Dedicated bench I'll try 1x and 2x-card equivalents and include token-cost estimates. Will post a short table in the kickoff doc.

sam_successops: Feedback mechanism: 3-question pulse after pilot + 20-min follow-up interview with product owner. Ill draft the survey and attach it to the doc.

priya_csm: Risks to flag now: procurement/PO delays (can push Dedicated start), legal/data-retention signoff (may block staging upload), and allowlist lead time. Add to the risk register.

oliver_cs: Also note: LumenCloud requested a 90-min power-user enablement session after Week 2. We'll schedule that separate from the kickoff.

lumencloud_pm: Confirming sample upload will happen Tue EOD. We'll also provide canonical prompt set and a contact for procurement.

priya_csm: Action owners from thread:
- oliver_cs: build kickoff doc + send calendar invite (owner)
- lumencloud_pm: upload redacted sample + procurement contact + legal POC (owner)
- jamie_se: SSO checklist + integration test plan (owner)
- rina_eng: Dedicated bench results + smoke test template (owner)
- sam_successops: success criteria + feedback survey (owner)
- priya_csm: risk register + schedule 30/60 health-checks (owner)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Fri Nov 3 8:30am PT "LumenCloud: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff"  invites sent. Link: https://meet.redwood/lumencloud-kickoff

jamie_se: I'll drop a short SSO checklist in the kickoff doc and call out required test creds format.

rina_eng: Plan to post bench numbers Wed after we get the sample.

priya_csm: Thanks everyone. If procurement/legal constraints emerge, flag them here so we can re-evaluate the timeline. See you Fri.
